text.tspan: One of the 13 phases of the DE4SDV increment workflow.
Per-increment obligations live in DE4SDV_IncrementWorkflow. No universal
category-string chain is active. Increment framing always applies; each
later step applies when the increment charter lists its phase, and the
steps of those phases declare the checks. Source relationships and
artifact identities, not populated shells, witness the required traces.
The disposition of a logical-to-software signal mapping (mapped, candidate, deferred, or notApplicable).
A control record for a logical or semantic information item crossing into a software,
service, topic, API, or physical boundary; preserves trace and review obligations
Reusable control-record shape for an interface-bearing logical or
semantic information item crossing into a software, service, topic, API,
or physical boundary. Exact .proto/.vsidl fields and runtime observations
remain in their authoritative external artifacts; this record preserves
the stable trace and review obligations. The record's short name is its
A reusable non-claiming allocation relationship from a logical/function signal
responsibility to a concrete software or adapter signal endpoint; the allocation
alone never proves field identity or runtime interoperability.
Reusable non-claiming allocation relationship from a logical/function
signal responsibility to a concrete software/adapter signal endpoint.
A specialization must still provide the typed payload/port, contract
mapping record, transformation, status, owner, next action, and evidence
or gap. The allocation alone never proves field identity or runtime
Size guidance for an increment (XS correction, S slice, M cross-viewpoint, L end-to-end baseline).
─── Assurance view for the method process itself ───
Reviewers need the DE4SDV method process to be visible: the phases
with their SAF domains, the recurring logical-to-software
signal-mapping control, and the increment size guidance.
Reviewers need claims, arguments, evidence, and gaps linked
in an assurance argument for the increment.
